messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — capturing action items for the GPU capacity / autoscale sequence we saw. Short summary: recurring surge Tue ~17:00 UTC, scheduler backpressure + quota exhaustion led to graceful-degrade failures. Need clear owners, dates, and quick wins.

Maya Chen: Action list (assignments below):
```
A1) Quota guard-rails + reserve pools          -> owner: Omar Patel   | RL-3421 | due 2026-04-02
A2) Scheduler backpressure tuning             -> owner: Samir Gupta  | RL-3440 | due 2026-03-30
A3) Headroom target + autoscale policy tests  -> owner: Lin Zhao     | RL-3452 | due 2026-04-06
A4) Post-deploy smoke & canary/runbook checks -> owner: Kevin Ortiz  | RL-3460 | due 2026-03-29
A5) Recurring-incident detection rule+alerts  -> owner: Maya Chen    | RL-3475 | due 2026-03-28
```

Maya Chen: Minimal canary load command (staging) to validate autoscale path:
```
loadtest --target /v1/generate --qps 30 --concurrency 16 --duration 10m
```

Omar Patel: taking A1.
Omar Patel: Plan: carve 10% reserve per GPU pool + quota thresholds that trigger spillover to dedicated tier. Will open subtask for tiering and link to RL-3421. ETA: 2026-04-02. :thumbsup:

Samir Gupta: taking A2.
Samir Gupta: Questions — what signals do we want to optimize for? My vote: sched_queue_length, pod_start_ms, and gpu_util tail percentiles. If we tune to reduce queue length we need to test synthetic bursts.

Lin Zhao: taking A3.
Lin Zhao: I'll add a staging experiment matrix and run two autoscale policies (aggressive vs conservative) during the Tue window. Need confirmation on a 2-hour maintenance window in staging on next Tue.

Kevin Ortiz: taking A4.
Kevin Ortiz: I'll add smoke steps to the deploy pipeline and a fast rollback hook that disables autoscale and reapplies previous model routing. Will paste runbook snippets here when ready.

ops-bot: RL tracker: https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3421, RL-3440, RL-3452, RL-3460, RL-3475. Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/gpu-autoscale-postmortem

Maya Chen: request: please add short bullet updates in the RL ticket daily until completion. I'll own A5 and the detection rule prototype (Alert -> auto-create RL ticket).

Omar Patel: suggested thresholds: reserve pool target = max(10% or 1 node) per pool. Also propose gradual quota cap increases with a 24h ramp to avoid sudden pressure.

Samir Gupta: noted. I'll include a small experiment in RL-3440 that runs a synthetic burst generator and measures pod_start_ms and KV-cache warm hit-rate.

Lin Zhao: re: recurring pattern — it looks like Tuesday evening request profile (batch inference clients) + cache cold starts. I think we should add a weekly metric dashboard row for "Tue 16-18 UTC" window and compare week-over-week.

Kevin Ortiz: I'll add the smoke checklist to the deploy pipeline today and include the rollback command: `kubectl apply -f deploy/previous.yaml && restart autoscaler`.

Maya Chen: can we set a recurring 20-min sync? Fridays 16:00 UTC to sweep progress and unblock owners. Who's ok?

Omar Patel: Friday 16:00 works for me.

Samir Gupta: ok for me.

Lin Zhao: ok. I'll bring staging schedule.

Kevin Ortiz: fine by me.

Samir Gupta: small ask — tag incidents we suspect are the same pattern with label `auto-scale-surge` and link to RL-3475. Makes it easier to search recurrence.

Maya Chen: good call, Samir. I'll update the incident taxonomy.

Omar Patel: also adding automated alert playbook: when sched_queue_length > X for 5m -> create RL ticket and ping #incidents with `@oncall` and `@sre`.

Lin Zhao: long-term note: batching + KV cache warmup improvements could reduce peak pressure by ~18% — tracking as backlog item in RL-3501 (post-q2).

Kevin Ortiz: owners: if you hit blockers or need infra changes (quota requests), ping me ASAP so I can escalate to infra procurement.

Maya Chen: final: I'll update the tracking doc and the RL ticket assignees now and post a short summary in #incidents. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: follow-ups due dates repeated: RL-3475 (2026-03-28), RL-3440 (2026-03-30), RL-3460 (2026-03-29), RL-3421 (2026-04-02), RL-3452 (2026-04-06).
